name: World time facts
notes: The world clock's facts (mw-ju8.6, mw-e27.12). The game clock (src/sim/gametime) is their only writer in a running game: it counts sim ticks into game minutes and advances them with advanceTime (rest, study, jail, travel). Rest at an inn passes time to 06:00 the next morning through it. Defaults match game.json's clock block (tests/integration/game-clock.test.ts).

facts.description: The in-world day number, 1 on the first day. Increases at each midnight the game clock crosses.
The minute of the in-world day, 0-1439 (360 = 06:00, a new world's start). Advances with sim ticks (150 ticks per game minute at 60 Hz and a 60-minute day) and with advanceTime.

The sim tick the current game minute is counted from; the running clock's remainder is the current tick minus this. Written once per game minute, so a save resumes mid-minute without a fact change every tick.
The sim tick a screen first held the clock at (dialogue, shop, inventory), or -1 while the clock runs. On release the held ticks are added to time.minute-origin so they do not count.
Id of the current phase of the day (dawn, day, dusk, night by default; phases are data in game.json). Written by the game clock whenever the phase changes, so conditions can test it.
